title: Deep learning predicts arterial stiffness from retinal fundus images in diabetes
summary: A deep-learning model trained on 64,440 images from 36,412 adults with diabetes reached AUC 0.780 internally and 0.772 externally (6,217 images, two hospitals). A fusion model with clinical factors reached AUC 0.853 on the test set and 0.801 externally. Ablation analyses suggested retinal arteries are associated with arterial stiffness; this retrospective analysis is exploratory on mechanism.
ai_technology: Deep-learning model on fundus images, fused with clinical factors
organization: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Ruijin Hospital

evidence.tested: Performance was assessed on internal test and two external hospital sets, with ablation by retinal structure.
evidence.unknown: AUCs are modest; pulse wave velocity is the reference and mechanism is not established. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep-learning model estimated pulse wave velocity-defined arterial stiffness from retinal photographs.
